items.text: Zay Flowers suffered a hamstring injury not considered serious; day-to-day, MRI upcoming, likely would have returned if game was close.
items.why: Sources say not serious; playoff game he likely returns
items.implication: Monitor practice; possible Week 2 return boosts Ravens pass game
items.opportunity: If out, more targets to Bateman/others

items.text: A.J. Brown high-ankle sprain, no surgery, expected miss ~6 weeks; placed on IR (min 4).
items.why: More serious high-ankle; Rapoport/Schefter confirm timeline
items.implication: Out until ~Week 7-8; NE WR depth elevated

items.text: Ladd McConkey left with chest/rib injury; updates pending from Aftermath.
items.implication: Week 2 status key for LAC WR

items.text: Brock Bowers after meniscus trim: Raiders believe realistic chance miss only 1 game, return Week 2 vs Chargers.
items.why: Meniscus trim Tuesday; walking unaided post-game
items.implication: Monitor Wed practice; Mayer TE1 if out

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected/out; Etienne 53 snaps/18 opps but didn't fully dominate (Miller 26 snaps/9 opps).
items.why: ETR expected not play; snaps confirm committee
items.implication: Etienne lead but not monopoly; Miller handcuff

items.text: Malik Nabers active and healthy in return from ACL+meniscus: 52% snaps, 71% routes, 31% target share (9 targets), 6-69-0.
items.why: First game since 9/28/25 tear; emerged healthy
items.opportunity: High route/target share even on limited snaps

items.text: Ja'Kobi Lane fractured wrist, miss several weeks; further testing/MRI.
items.implication: Ravens WR depth thin with Flowers too

items.text: Start Malik Nabers everywhere post-active (decoy risk but worth it).
Sunday AM: Love/Odunze expected to play; Kamara not; Nabers pending (later active). Post-game watch Flowers/McConkey/Lane.
items.implication: Kamara absence boosts Etienne; Nabers resolved active

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. has zero career games with 8+ catches; Bourne debuted 8-75-0 in ARI.
items.why: Career pattern of limited high-catch games

items.text: Dalton Kincaid over PCL: 74% snaps (42/57), 69% routes on Allen dropbacks.
items.why: Finally past PCL issue; high involvement

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout SZN well underway.
items.implication: Start/roster as TE upside with Andrews

items.text: Buy low on Colston Loveland; still want Bears offense pieces despite Week 1.
items.why: Preseason love; Week 1 weirdness not panicking

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks real after preseason talk with new OC; more than hype.
